audit.why: Exactly 50% over 608 games; EVEN at 6/10 is right. The lane trades hands repeatedly rather than being owned by either side.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Skill, Illaoi, Illaoi, Skill, Skill, Illaoi, Illaoi. The packet says Poppy, Poppy, Illaoi, Illaoi, Poppy, Illaoi, Poppy.
audit.why: The whys already spell out the packet shape: Poppy owns 1-2 on early tankiness, Illaoi takes 3-4 with Test of Spirit, Poppy takes 6 with Keeper's Verdict, Illaoi takes the first-item window, Poppy out-tanks at 2+ items.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 4 and 6 flipped to Poppy and row 3 to Illaoi, each as a matched full+content pair.

audit.whatIsWrong: The shield was attributed to her W, the dash-block was called passive, and Keeper's Verdict was claimed to cancel Leap of Faith mid-cast.
audit.why: Riot's kit: the shield is the passive, Iron Ambassador (buckler pickup). Steadfast Presence's passive half is armour and MR that grows as she drops low; the dash-block, slow and ground come from the 20/18/16/14/12s active — and that active is what stops Harsh Lesson, which is the decisive interaction in this lane. Whether Keeper's Verdict interrupts Illaoi's R is not in either file, so I did not restate it.
audit.corrected: Shield moved to the passive, dash-block tied to the active with its 20s rank-1 cooldown and the ground/slow it applies to your W, and the R rewritten around the knock-away plus its 140s cost.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers anywhere despite Steadfast Presence being the single gate on your engage.
audit.why: 20s at rank 1 is an enormous window for a 4s W — baiting the active is the whole lane.
audit.corrected: Numbers added to spikes[0].text and spikes[1].text.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2].text and late both said the lane re-favours Poppy at first item, while the chart row for first item says Illaoi.
audit.why: Two layers of the same page were answering the first-item question differently. The packet and win[5] both say Illaoi.
audit.corrected: Rewrote both to put the first-item window on your side and keep Poppy's ownership at 6 and at 2+ items.

edits.before: At level 1 Poppy's W-shield and early tankiness win the opening trade before your E.
edits.after: At level 1 Poppy's buckler shield and Hammer Shock zone win the trade before your E.

edits.before: Your window is level 3-4: once E Test of Spirit is up, pull Poppy's soul when her W Steadfast Presence is down — that's the only phase her dash-block doesn't punish your movement. Note her E Heroic Charge can only stun you against a wall, so fight in open lane and stack Q slaps on the vessel.
edits.after: Your window is level 3-4: with Test of Spirit (E) up, rip her soul while Steadfast Presence is down — 20s at rank 1, and while it is active it stops Harsh Lesson dead, slowing and grounding you. Heroic Charge only stuns against a wall, so fight in open lane and stack Q slaps on the vessel.

edits.before: Poppy's R Keeper's Verdict can cancel your R Leap of Faith mid-cast and knock you away, so 6 tilts back to her. Don't lead all-ins with your R here — bait her ultimate first, then commit with the tentacle ring.
edits.after: Keeper's Verdict (R) is a 140s channel that knocks you very far away, so level 6 tilts back to her: out of your field you have no tentacles. Never lead with Leap of Faith — bait her ultimate, then commit into the ring.

edits.before: After first item the lane re-favours Poppy: her W passively blocks dashes and grants armor/MR while active, and her tankiness lets her survive your tentacle field. Fight only when her W and R are on cooldown.
edits.after: First item is yours: Steadfast Presence gives armour and MR passively but only blocks dashes while the active runs, so bait it, then W in. With Iceborn and stacked tentacles you out-damage her through the shield.

edits.before: Poppy re-takes the lane at 5 and again with items: her dash-blocking W, armor/MR steroid, and R disengage keep this an even-to-losing brawl, so cash your level-3-4 and level-6-bait spikes and consider sidelaning.
edits.after: Level 6 belongs to Poppy, but first item swings back to you: her dash-blocking W and Keeper's Verdict disengage are on long cooldowns, so fight in those gaps and use the sidelane, where her peel matters least.

notes: The packet's suspectName flag on wants.foe[0] ('Keep Steadfast Presence') is a FALSE POSITIVE — Steadfast Presence is the correct W name; the near-miss is just the leading verb. Real errors found instead: the shield belongs to the passive Iron Ambassador, not W, and the dash-block is the W active (20s at rank 1), not a passive. That active grounding Harsh Lesson is the decisive interaction of the lane and was never stated. Removed the unverified claim that Keeper's Verdict cancels Leap of Faith mid-cast — neither kit file supports it. Chart was wrong on five of seven rows.
